name: nonApi_thirdPartySignIn
description: Sign in with Apple/Google, verified rebuild (E1.F1.S8). Called ONLY by the API's ThirdPartySignIn endpoint after it has verified the provider's signed identity token; every identity value comes from inside that token. Finds the hasher by provider id, else by the provider's VERIFIED email (linking it), else creates one (reset code from trgGenerateQrCode). Returns the reset code; the app signs the phone in with it via hcapp_authorizeDevice. Removed/deleted accounts refused. Idempotency: locked-upsert (app lock on provider + id).

parameters.name: emailVerified
parameters.description: 1 when the token says the email is verified.

parameters.name: firstName
parameters.description: From the app (Apple sends names only on first authorisation); used only for a new account.

columns.name: ResetCode
columns.description: URC:… — the app signs in with it

columns.name: Linked
columns.description: 1 = an existing account was linked by verified email now

sideEffects: May link HC.Hasher.ThirdParty* on an existing hasher
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
